description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'SubjectIdInvalidException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It indicates invalid Subject ID errors in policy validation, providing constructors, static factory methods, and a builder pattern. The exception is annotated and implements interfaces relevant to Ditto's exception hierarchy and JSON schema support.

classes.name: SubjectIdInvalidException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when a Subject ID is invalid, specifically when it lacks the required issuer delimiter. It extends 'DittoRuntimeException' and implements 'PolicyException', with static factory methods and internal builder class.

methods.name: SubjectIdInvalidException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with the invalid subject ID, setting default message and description.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an instance from a custom message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns supported JSON schema versions for this exception.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with specified Ditto headers.
